name: Hamilton Lane Senior Credit Opportunities Securitize Fund
oneLiner: HLSCOPE is Hamilton Lane's SCOPE senior secured private-credit fund tokenized via Securitize for qualified purchasers, priced at NAV rather than $1.
collateral: Tokenized feeder exposure to Hamilton Lane Senior Credit Opportunities Fund (SCOPE), targeting floating-rate senior secured loans to private borrowers in sectors such as healthcare, information technology, and business services.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tokenized feeder-fund share rather than a fixed $1 peg; qualified purchasers access monthly subscriptions and on-demand redemptions at the previous quarter's NAV per share through Securitize's digital process.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: HLSCOPE was first tokenized through Securitize on Polygon and is now tracked on Ethereum and Optimism as well. Public multichain evidence points to Wormhole-enabled interoperability, so the route is reviewed conservatively as an external lock/mint route.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: HLSCOPE is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: HLSCOPE uses Securitize DSToken UUPS proxies on Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Plume, and Tron. The four EVM deployments share owner EOA 0x59c1eAcE...76Ee; Tron uses owner EOA TGmCDF...6huia. Both reviewed owners hold the trust-service MASTER role on their respective reviewed branches, which authorizes issuance and UUPS upgrades. No permissionless mint route exists.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531417, the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xa2f6ef3144753f31fcd728910b96a92bbbb462c9, the admin slot was zero, and owner() returned code-empty EOA 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee. Verified DSToken source exposes privileged issuance and UUPS upgrade surfaces.

controls.label: HLSCOPE Securitize DSToken issuance surface (Plume)
controls.evidence: At Plume block 81057700, HLSCOPE was a UUPS proxy with implementation 0x0d12bd2941f61b84f01342b3248ef1dedcd0c344 and a zero EIP-1967 admin slot. owner() returned code-empty EOA 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee; its trust service returned role 1 (MASTER) for that owner, satisfying the verified DSToken issuance and UUPS authorization gates.

controls.label: HLSCOPE Securitize DSToken issuance surface (Tron)
controls.evidence: On 2026-07-14, Tronscan identified the token as an ERC-1967 proxy using verified implementation TPEAnjjT35bqVPJ39ohdJSSfXdWxRPrTFT. TronGrid owner() returned TGmCDF656XokXcpJsvBZsdinQzgru6huia, the token trust service resolved to THCip3txeTF1nsxk1n3fKt6KwTXxEpzvau, and getRole(owner) returned 1 (MASTER). The owner account was non-contract, and the verified implementation exposes privileged issuance and UUPS upgrade methods.

controls.label: HLSCOPE shared EVM token owner
controls.evidence: Exact-block owner() and eth_getCode reads confirmed this same code-empty EOA on Ethereum block 25531417, Polygon block 90222365, Optimism block 154219883, and Plume block 81057700. On Plume, getRole(owner) returned MASTER; verified DSToken source permits MASTER accounts to issue tokens and authorizes UUPS upgrades through onlyMaster.

controls.label: HLSCOPE Tron token owner
controls.evidence: On 2026-07-14, TronGrid owner() returned this non-contract account and the token's trust service returned role 1 (MASTER) for it. That role satisfies the verified implementation's privileged issuance and UUPS authorization gates.

sources.label: Hamilton Lane and Securitize HLSCOPE NAV integration

review.evidence: The full five-deployment registry was re-verified on 2026-07-14. Exact-block EVM reads resolved implementations 0xa2f6...62c9 (Ethereum block 25531417), 0x5e98...2e0b (Polygon block 90222365), 0x05ea...63ae (Optimism block 154219883), and 0x0d12...c344 (Plume block 81057700); each proxy had a zero EIP-1967 admin slot and returned shared code-empty owner EOA 0x59c1...76Ee. Plume's trust service returned MASTER for that owner. Tronscan and TronGrid identified Tron proxy TSwy...TPht1X, implementation TPEA...PrTFT, trust service THCi...zvau, and non-contract owner TGmC...6huia with MASTER role. Verified DSToken implementations gate privileged issuance at ISSUER-or-above and UUPS upgrades at MASTER. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: HLSCOPE uses RedStone TSSO to deliver issuer-provided NAV for pricing and redemptions, but no dated independent supply-to-fund-assets reconciliation was found. Its Rule 506(c) and Investment Company Act Section 3(c)(7) exemptions do not prudentially supervise the fund.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)

sources.label: Hamilton Lane SCOPE via Securitize announcement

reserveReview.rationale: HLSCOPE is a tokenized feeder into Hamilton Lane's SCOPE senior credit opportunities fund, which targets floating-rate senior secured loans to private borrowers. The 95/5 split between senior secured loans and the cash liquidity buffer follows SCOPE's documented strategy of remaining predominantly invested with a liquidity sleeve; neither publisher discloses a current position-level holdings file, so the loan bucket is one aggregate classified exposure rather than invented obligor weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Securitize and Hamilton Lane SCOPE fund strategy disclosures; position-level holdings are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The underlying loan portfolio's obligors, sector weights, and current funded-versus-cash allocation are not published at position level; the 95/5 split is an approximation of the documented predominantly-invested strategy, not a reported allocation.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: SCOPE's private-credit positions are not published at position level, so the bucket cannot be split into reviewed obligor exposures.
Fund-level cash is an external reserve asset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

sources.label: Hamilton Lane SCOPE via Securitize announcement

custodyProfile.uncertainty: HLSCOPE is a feeder-fund interest: fund assets sit with the underlying Hamilton Lane fund's custodian under a fund structure that is bankruptcy-remote from the tokenization entity by design, but the reviewed materials do not name the custodian or publish account-level segregation and reuse terms.
